name: Devasena
dates_notes: The author is conventionally placed in the late ninth or tenth century. The dating and biographical identifications depend on colophons and later Digambara tradition and remain provisional.
core_thesis: Devasena is significant for Digambara self-description and historical classification. His works organize doctrinal categories, ascetic practice, and accounts of Jaina subtraditions, providing evidence for how medieval Jains understood their own internal diversity.

engaged_works.title: Darsanasara
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Traditionally and generally ascribed to Devasena, though detailed historical claims in the text require independent source criticism.
engaged_works.summary: A concise account of Jaina sects and lineages. It is indispensable evidence for medieval Digambara sectarian memory but should not be used as an uncritical record of early history.

engaged_works.title: Bhavasangraha
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Attributed to Devasena in Digambara transmission; work-level attribution should be checked against a critical edition before reader implementation.
engaged_works.summary: A compendious treatment of Jaina categories and spiritual states. It is included provisionally as a source for Devasena's doctrinal reception, not as a basis for unverified quotations.
